case.summary: Case CASE-020 (Card SC-03020-K954): The real-time risk model scored transaction 4012182 at 0.88, triggering review [EV-652b0de9]. The card (SC-03020-K954) showed two prior transactions averaging $30 and three online transactions within 48 hours of the flagged event [EV-c407827e, EV-71f61ccc]. The transaction originated from a device marked 'New' for this account (IOS Device profile) and used an anonymous proxy connection from Argentina [EV-0c830829, EV-a81a85f3]. One prior confirmed fraud case (CC-4325) exists for this customer/card, and the same device profile appears in a confirmed fraud case [EV-dd52f6cd, EV-10a14ff6]. Six prior closed cases share the 'card_not_present_new_device' pattern [EV-b135fdef]. The customer disputes the transactions, stating they did not make the purchases and retain physical possession of the card [EV-ad90a196].

sar.narrative: This Suspicious Activity Report covers CASE-020, a confirmed fraud investigation involving three card-not-present transactions (4012182, 4012183, 4012184) totaling $97.42 in exposure. The initial transaction (4012182, $37.42) was flagged by the real-time risk model with a score of 0.88 [EV-652b0de9]. Analysis revealed the transactions originated from a previously unseen iOS device profile and an anonymous proxy IP geolocated to Argentina, both indicators consistent with account takeover [EV-0c830829, EV-a81a85f3]. The card's recent history shows elevated online velocity (three transactions in 48 hours) against a low average ticket size [EV-c407827e, EV-71f61ccc]. The device fingerprint has been linked to a prior confirmed fraud case, and the customer (SC-03020) has a previous fraud record (CC-4325) [EV-dd52f6cd, EV-10a14ff6]. The customer has affirmatively denied authorizing the transactions and confirms physical card possession [EV-ad90a196]. The pattern aligns with six prior 'card_not_present_new_device' cases, supporting a systematic threat vector [EV-b135fdef]. Based on the totality of evidence, the activity is consistent with unauthorized card-not-present fraud facilitated by device compromise and proxy obfuscation.
